title: Geekvape Aegis Legend 5 Vape Kit
description: The Geek Vape Aegis Legend 5 Vape Kit is a powerful and durable sub-ohm device built for performance in any environment. Designed around Geek Vape’s signature tri-proof protection, this dual-battery mod delivers up to 200W of adjustable output while offering resistance to water, dust, and shock for dependable vaping in demanding conditions. Driven by Geek Vape’s upgraded AS 4.0 chipset, the Legend 5 fires in just 0.01 seconds and supports multiple modes including Smart, Power, Boost, ECO, Temperature Control, and Memory, giving vapers the flexibility to fine-tune their experience. A crisp 1.08” TFT display provides real-time data with ambient lighting for intuitive control at a glance. The kit is paired with the Geek Vape Z Sub-Ohm Tank (2ml), known for its top airflow design that minimises leaks and delivers excellent vapour production. Pre-installed with a 0.15ohm Z XM Mesh Coil and supplied with a spare 0.4ohm coil, the tank is ideal for use with high-VG e-liquids and supports a wide wattage range to suit different DTL preferences. With its motorsport-inspired metal C-frame, textured airflow dial, and practical A-Lock switch, the Legend 5 balances rugged aesthetics with smart usability. The device is powered by two 18650 batteries (sold separately) and features USB-C fast charging for added convenience. Geek Vape Aegis Legend 5 Kit - Everest sunrise - 10 Year Anniversary Edition Commemorating ten years of pioneering vape hardware, the Everest Sunrise - 10 Year Anniversary Edition reflects Geek Vape’s position at the summit of vaping. This unique colourway features fortified design elements and precise trademark engravings that pay tribute to Geek Vape's history. While maintaining the same hard-wearing tri-proof protection and performance as the standard motorsport-inspired models, this edition offers a distinctive look for vapers who appreciate the spirit of adventure. Whether you’re a dedicated cloud chaser or an experienced user seeking a hard-wearing everyday setup, the Aegis Legend 5 offers power, protection, and precision in one robust package. We Recommend using High VG (Sub-Ohm) E-liquid with this Kit. Please Note: Batteries are NOT included with this kit or a USB-C Charging Cable. Please Note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Coils, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
